# Awesome Short-Form Video

> A curated list of open tools and official docs for making vertical short video for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and
> Facebook Reels with code, the command line or agents: rendering from code, editing and cutting, clipping pipelines,
> transcription and captions, voice, agent skills and MCP servers, specs and safe zones, posting and measuring. Every link is
> checked in CI. CC0.

- [README](https://github.com/viewgum/awesome-short-form-video/blob/main/README.md): the list
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/viewgum/awesome-short-form-video/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): what gets in

## Related

- [Free creator tools in the browser](https://viewgum.com/tools): compress, trim, crop, convert and check video without installing anything
